research_question: Does the prime-count regime of the immediately preceding main-number draw contain cutoff-safe information about next-draw number inclusion, sufficient to improve a deterministic three-line disjoint union18 portfolio over the exact geometry-matched null?
novelty_statement: One frozen three-bin prime-count transition signal family. It is distinct in feature definition from E049 sum/odd/low/consecutive draw state, E063 last-digit occupancy, E066 five-component gap shape, E050 neighbor distance, E053 lag-two membership, E048 bonus transition, and B-model selectors. It is not a claim of statistical independence. One estimator, one portfolio selector, one historical evaluation; no variants or tuning.
training_cutoff_rule: For target t, use only draws 1..t-1. For each historical transition outcome u=2..t-1, use prime_count_state(draw u-1) as the feature and the six main numbers of draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draw t-1, then add target t only after scoring.

feature_definition.source: The immediately preceding draw's six main numbers only; bonus is excluded.
feature_definition.prime_count: Count prime numbers among the previous draw's six main numbers.

state_components.prime_count_bin: 0 if count<=1; 1 if count==2; 2 if count>=3

feature_definition.distance: Hamming distance across the one frozen categorical prime-count component.
feature_definition.transition_history: For each historical outcome round u=2..t-1, use the prime-count state of draw u-1 as the feature and the six main numbers of draw u as the outcome. Score target t from draw t-1, then add target t only after scoring.
feature_definition.candidate_universe: All integers 1..45 are scored for every target.

estimator.conditional_count: Weighted count of each main number in historical transition outcomes.
estimator.global_rate: Count of each main number in draws 1..t-1 divided by t-1.

portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.
portfolio.selection: Three sequential calls to the unchanged E045 choose_disjoint_ticket selector, passing the E067 score as both role_score and global_score; remove selected numbers after each line.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line-incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.

prospective_confirmation.readiness_rule: Even if the historical gate passes, do not create STRICT_PASS_READY or release purchase lines until the policy owner formally predeclares the prospective minimum target count and completion rule.

promotion_rule: Evaluate this single preregistered axis once. No variants, threshold changes, alpha changes, block-length changes, comparator changes, or parameter search after observing results. Historical failure remains failure. Historical pass alone cannot create purchase readiness because prospective confirmation is required and currently unspecified.
preregistration_hashing: This preregistration is committed before E067 outcome statistics are computed; the frozen runner, test, workflow, E045 base helper, and three-line policy blobs are checked before execution.
